answer: A bond is refunded only after 26 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The ridge counter is kept in wharf and canyon reveals each reset. An farming party thus has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 26 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 10 times over for the same share of the pool. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
